Name: Trophy Room
Description: Glass cases. Season trophies, and anything else you have been told to be proud of.
Notes: data/Trophies.csv. A trophy is a NAME AND A CONDITION - it does not have to come from a competition, so `three wins` is as good a trophy as a cup final.

Name: Club House
Description: Upgrades for the club, and the recruitment board. An achievement gives you the right to buy an upgrade; this is where you pay for it.
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony): THE UPGRADE SHOP - data/Upgrades.csv. Resting moved to the Dorms. THE RECRUITMENT BOARD (round AH) is still here: data/RecruitBoard.csv.

Name: Dorms
Description: Where every player rests - after a match, an Adventure or a brew - and how many players you may keep.
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony): THE RESTING AREA FOR ALL PLAYERS - data/Resting.csv says what sends a player to bed and for how long, data/Recovery.csv how long by power. Beds are data/Dorms.csv: the first row is FREE and the rest are bought.

Name: Training Ground
Description: Ausbildung for the whole side — or one of the five games that automate a Brewery section.
Notes: data/Training.csv, and the Kind column splits it: `ausbildung` trains a number, `minigame` automates a Brewery section. A mini-game buys that section another vat today; the played game goes on top of it later.

Name: Pub
Description: Ten seats, ten drinks, and a cheer. Whoever is not in the room plays as a basic unit.
Notes: TONIGHT'S TEN. `pub_ten` in Tuning.csv turns the ten-seat room on; while it is off, everybody may drink.

Name: Brewery
Description: Six sections and a yard. Barley in at one end, bottles out at the other.
Notes: OPENS ITS OWN MAP inside the window. Each of the six sections is unlocked separately, and a section with player units in it will one day produce on its own after every match - the Batches column is where that foundation already sits.

Name: The Traveling Tavern
Description: A wagon, a horse and a man who knows exactly what you have run out of.
Notes: ROUND AN: RENAMED from The Traveling Brewer (Anthony). Only the Name changed - the ID and the unlock it waits on (Traveling Brewer) are the same, so saves are untouched. HE IS THE PRESSURE VALVE ON THE BREWERY, and he sells one thing at a time at a premium. The money is data/Currencies.csv and every match mode has its own - a season match pays coins, a quick match pays marks, a cup tie pays silver.
